##### Project general facts

Anta MediSpa Villas Resort is a premium complex of 58 private villas and 14 hotel rooms located in Uluwatu, designed as a harmonious integration with the natural landscape. The architecture emphasizes privacy, spaciousness, and a strong connection to nature, with villas surrounded by jungle greenery and offering panoramic ocean views. The project features a well-structured master plan with a main building, villa collection, and a dedicated health and longevity center, all positioned within a 10,400 m² land plot. A key highlight of the exterior concept is direct access to a private beach just 200 meters away, enhancing the exclusivity and resort atmosphere.

The infrastructure of the project is built around a comprehensive wellness and lifestyle concept. Residents and guests have access to a multi-level medical and wellness center that includes diagnostics, preventive medicine, detox and longevity programs, spa facilities, and modern therapies. The complex also features a jungle gym, lounge zones, rooftop infinity pool, and two restaurants with ocean views offering both healthy cuisine and à la carte dining. Additional amenities include a sport center nearby, event and relaxation spaces, and a fully integrated environment designed to support health, recovery, and a comfortable lifestyle.

Each villa is designed with a focus on quality, functionality, and refined aesthetics. Interiors feature designer finishes, premium materials, and modern spaces complemented by subtle Balinese accents. The layout emphasizes comfort and personalization, with private gardens, swimming pools, and spacious living areas. The design approach combines contemporary style with natural elements, creating a calm and elegant atmosphere tailored for long-term living and relaxation, while maintaining a high standard of quality and attention to detail.

##### Parking 

Shared parking. 

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled on a lush green hilltop in Uluwatu within Badung regency, this exceptional location places residents in one of Bali’s most prestigious coastal districts and the island's most popular tourist area. The neighborhood offers panoramic ocean views, refreshing island breezes, and a serene atmosphere that attracts discerning travelers from around the world. Uluwatu is renowned for its dramatic cliffs, world-class surf breaks, and some of the island’s most iconic beach clubs, with one of the most popular surf beaches in the world just a two-minute walk away.

The location is distinguished by its exceptional convenience and vibrant lifestyle offerings. Just a short walk from the complex, visitors can access the area’s most popular beach clubs, countless restaurants, wellness spas, and fitness centers. The neighborhood is also home to a strong international community, premium boutiques, and cultural attractions that enhance daily life. Unlike more crowded areas, this location offers a peaceful retreat without sacrificing access to world-class amenities.

For those seeking a residence that embodies both tranquility and prestige, Uluwatu delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of natural beauty, limited development, soaring interiors, ocean views from every unit, and proximity to the island’s finest attractions makes it a top choice for discerning investors and homeowners. This is a place where one can enjoy the best of Bali, serene, sophisticated and effortlessly inspiring.
